flash_695477.description: Although desire is a mere emotion, the Aseret HaDibrot prohibit it when it is misdirected.

flash_695475.description:
Police and prosecutors had planned to inform the Supreme Court on Thursday that the criminal investigation into the Mount Meron disaster would be reopened. However, the police legal adviser requested a one-month delay in submitting the notification, according to a report in Haaretz.

According to the report, the legal adviser, who is close to Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana, justified the request by citing the need to clarify certain matters with Police Commissioner Dani Levy.

flash_695474.description: At least three children and one adult killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Suspect shot and killed.

flash_695473.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit clarified, "Following the incident in the area of Ateret, an initial inquiry determined that the incident was not terror-related."

The driver was transferred to security forces, and officers from the Judea and Samaria District Police opened an investigation to establish the circumstances of the accident.

flash_695472.description: Several people, including children, injured in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Police say the gunman is dead and at least two were hospitalized.

flash_695493.description: Flavio Bolsonaro leads Brazilian President Lula 47% to 45% in a new Datafolha poll ahead of the October 25 runoff, narrowing his previous four-point advantage.

flash_695492.description: Marking two years since Yahya Sinwar's elimination, the IDF releases a handwritten document in which the Hamas leader ordered terrorists to document atrocities on October 7.

flash_695490.description: Indonesia's leading Islamic council calls for the cancellation of two Andrea Bocelli concerts, citing the Italian tenor's support for Israel and its military.

flash_695488.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi urges Israel to reverse Jewish community construction in Judea and Samaria and reaffirms Beijing's support for a Palestinian state.

flash_695487.description: US Central Command disputes Iranian claims of control over the Strait of Hormuz, the sinking of a Singapore-flagged ship and hundreds of American military deaths.

flash_695485.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi reiterates Beijing's support for Palestinian statehood and a two-state solution.

flash_695483.description: Trump when asked if he trusts Netanyahu: I don't trust anybody

flash_695482.description: President Trump says he will not use nuclear weapons against Iran and has no plans to deploy ground troops, amid reports of a possible MOAB strike.

flash_695478.description: Proofpoint agrees to acquire Israeli-founded cybersecurity company Varonis for $6.3 billion in cash, combining their data protection and AI security capabilities.

flash_695476.description: Judaism, not ancient Greece, is foundational to the moral greatness of the West. Opinion.

flash_695510.description: Avshalom Revivo, 61, swerved his bus to protect 20 soldiers in a decision his employer believes saved their lives - but paid for it with his own life.

flash_695509.description: Noach had a duty not only to prepare for his own survival, but to give others the chance to save themselves. But there would never be enough room for that.

flash_695507.description: It does not seem logical that Jews living in lands whose rainy seasons differ from that of Eretz Yisrael should ask for rain according to the calendar of Eretz Yisrael!

flash_695505.description: MK Yuli Edelstein faces a heated confrontation aboard flight as left-wing activist hurls insults and accusations at him, while another activist calls for politicians to be pursued everywhere.

flash_695503.description: Police, Border Police, and Shin Bet launch extensive searches for masked individual wearing IDF uniform who may be armed.

flash_695501.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan faces backlash after calling for religion's removal from public spaces; Shas leader Aryeh Deri hits back.

flash_695499.description: While the Torah places Noach's Ark on the mountains of Ararat, a closer look at the Rambam and Midrash suggests the ark may have ultimately come to rest near the future site of the Holy Temple.

flash_695497.description: Anti-Zionist Jews will do anything to try to preserve their position in society but they are playing a losing game with the non-Jewish world. And their abysmal response to October 7 showed their fellow Jews all their cards. Opinion.

flash_695495.description: Elon Musk unveils Tesla's new Roadster with rocket-like thrusters, showcasing aerial stunts and acceleration from 0 to 60 mph in under a second. Production is targeted for 2028.

flash_695491.description: After Yoav Horowitz accused Netanyahu of being a "Qatari agent," the Likud announces that the Prime Minister would file a 500,000-shekel defamation lawsuit.

flash_695489.description: German court sentences two men for plotting attacks on prominent pro-Israel figures on behalf of Iran's Quds Force and conducting surveillance of Jewish targets.

flash_695486.description: Three children - aged 5, 8, and 11 - and a teacher murdered in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Shooter, a 16-year-old, shot and killed.

flash_695484.description: Prof. Yaron Zelekha unveils his party's economic platform, declaring he will join only a Zionist government that supports universal military service and appoints him finance minister.

flash_695519.description: The terrorist infiltrated the Re’im Base during the October 7 massacre and recently advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, in violation of the ceasefire.

flash_695518.description:
Johannes Natland, a 19-year-old Norwegian, was sentenced to 20 years in prison in the UK on Friday after being convicted of conspiracy to commit murder on behalf of the Swedish criminal network Foxtrot, which is linked to the Iranian regime.

Natland was arrested in March 2025 in a hotel room in northern England, hours before the planned murder, with two firearms and ammunition in his possession. He admitted possessing the weapons but denied intending to carry out the killing.

London police stressed that no evidence had been found linking Iran directly to this particular case.

flash_695517.description:
A paraglider was filmed flying in violation of the law and regulations in the airspace near Nevatim Airbase on Friday morning. The base is one of the Israeli Air Force’s most sensitive installations.

According to a report by Doron Kadosh, the paraglider did not enter the base’s grounds but landed nearby, in an area inhabited by Bedouins. The incident was reported to the Israel Police.

flash_695516.description:
The Central Elections Committee announced that voting for the 26th Knesset has concluded at Israeli missions around the world. Of the 4,863 eligible voters, 4,218 cast their ballots, representing a turnout of 86.7% - an increase of 17.1 percentage points compared with the previous election.

Voting took place at 101 polling stations across 99 Israeli missions, beginning in New Zealand and ending on the US West Coast. The ballot envelopes will be transferred to Israel ahead of the vote count.

flash_695515.description: Footage from Abu Falah appears to show Israeli youths helping photographer Heidi Levine to her feet, despite claims that hilltop youth kicked her 50 times and broke her legs.

flash_695514.description:
Two haredi draft evaders were randomly stopped by police in Rishon Lezion on Thursday. After it was determined that both were classified as IDF deserters, they were transferred to the Military Police in accordance with established procedures.

According to a haredi organization that assists draft evaders, the two were sentenced to 20 days in military jail on Friday.

flash_695513.description:
The IDF responded to the attack on a Washington post photographer, saying: "Earlier today (Friday), IDF and Border Police forces were dispatched to an area adjacent to Khirbet Abu Falah, following a report of a violent confrontation. Foreign media personnel were present at the scene and a female journalist had been injured during the confrontation. All circumstances surrounding the incident will be examined."

"Upon arriving at the scene, the forces acted to disperse the confrontation using riot dispersal means.

"At another location where the confrontation took place, IDF soldiers fired warning shots into the air and subsequently toward a suspect who ran toward them carrying a sharp object and posed a threat to them. The confrontation was dispersed."

The IDF added: "Police forces and forensic investigators from the Judea and Samaria District will enter the area with IDF security to collect findings and evidence, as well as take testimonies."

"The IDF strongly condemns this incident and views any manifestation of violence with utmost severity. Attempts to incite friction between populations undermine security in the area. Attacks and violence against innocent civilians are grave and unacceptable acts that require a coordinated, multi-agency response. The IDF will work together with the relevant authorities to eradicate this phenomenon."

flash_695512.description: Clash in Abu Falah during olive harvest leaves Washington Post photographer injured, report says.

flash_695511.description: Several Israelis lightly injured as Palestinian Arab rioters throw rocks, launch fireworks, and torch farmland in Binyamin; regional council accuses Palestinian Authority of direct involvement.

Yisrael Beytenu chairman Avigdor Liberman accuses Gadi Eisenkot of seeking a coalition with Netanyahu, Deri, and Goldknopf: "Gadi Eisenkot is Benny Gantz 2."

flash_695536.description: In a CNN interview, Israeli Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter condemns violence in Judea and Samaria, promising to bring rioters to justice, while noting discrepancy between number of Jewish and Arab victims.

flash_695535.description: Newly revealed war cabinet transcripts expose explosive disagreements between Netanyahu and Israel's security chiefs over Gaza, Hezbollah, Syria, and decisions that shaped the course of the war.

flash_695533.description: Jewish shepherd injured in Samaria after Palestinian Arab swerves and rams him, sending him flying through the air.

flash_695529.description: Diplomats from France, Belgium, and Poland report being attacked during an olive harvest near Taybeh; Israel condemns violence and launches investigation.

flash_695545.description: Jews outside Israel vs. Jews in Israel on praying for rain.

flash_695544.description:
A 21-year-old Palestinian Arab was killed after a vehicle struck him on Route 443 near the Ofer checkpoint.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams arriving at the scene found him not breathing and with no pulse, and were forced to declare his death at the scene.

flash_695543.description: Shots ring out near a packed political gathering in Lod as Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich warns that illegal weapons in Arab communities pose a growing threat to Israel's security.

flash_695542.description: Binyamin Netanyahu and his natural partner Bezalel Smotrich are the reliable leaders. The alternatives are like swimmers who sincerely and absurdly believe they can negotiate with sharks. Op-ed.

flash_695541.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemns attack on Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine, calling it an 'act of terror,' demanding arrest, prosecution of those responsible.

flash_695539.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warns of 'very harsh response' if Iran attempts attack before elections, vows to crack down on 'affliction' of Jewish violence in Judea and Samaria.

flash_695537.description: Gunshots heard in Lod during conference attended by Finance Min. Bezalel Smotrich

flash_695534.description: Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar recounts brutal attack in cockpit as Flight 1073 plunged, struggling to stay conscious and regain control; despite his ordeal, he vows to fly again.

flash_695532.description:
Yisrael Ganz, Governor of the Binyamin Regional Council and Chairman of the Yesha Council, added, "In the past two days, groups of provocateurs and terrorists have been creating chaos under the pretext of the olive harvest. They arrive at known friction points to inflame tensions and provoke confrontations. In many cases, they are the actual aggressors, rioting and attacking Israelis. They must not be allowed to continue operating unchecked."

"At the same time, Israelis who resort to violence are playing into their hands and causing harm to innocent people, to the communities of Judea and Samaria, and to the State of Israel.

"I call on the police to take responsibility and restore order. A police force that knows how to combat organized crime must also stop stone-throwers and the organizers of premeditated disturbances at known flashpoints, whether they are Israeli, Arab, or foreigners, rather than settling for condemnations and announcing that an investigation has been opened after the incident has already ended."

flash_695530.description: IDF eliminates four Hamas terrorists in separate strikes across Gaza, including Nukhba operative, sniper, and terrorist who infiltrated Israel during October 7 massacre.

flash_695546.description: Channel 14 host Yinon Magal clarifies controversy after calling Gadi Eisenkot a "monkey," citing criminal underworld slang.

flash_695540.description: President Isaac Herzog calls Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine following assault in Binyamin Region, condemning violence and demanding authorities bring those responsible to justice.

flash_695538.description: As Israel's election approaches, opposition figures are reportedly working behind the scenes to prevent Trump from endorsing Netanyahu and influencing the battle to form the next government.

flash_695551.description: An explosion at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta leaves an unknown number dead and injured, as high winds fuel a major fire near the military facility.

flash_695550.description: Yisrael Beytenu leader Avigdor Liberman outlines a plan to pass legislation barring indicted candidates from taking office.

flash_695548.description: Child and adult killed and several others injured when a vehicle drives onto a soccer field in Wichita, Kansas. Police say the driver is in custody.

flash_695567.description: Dozens of protesters from the Jerusalem Faction blocked the Gan Yavne Interchange in protest against the arrests of military draft evaders, hours before a planned demonstration on Highway 4.

flash_695566.description: After finding that the driver of the suspicious Renault was unauthorized to enter Israeli territory, IDF and Border Police forces opened the trunk and found three more illegal entrants.

flash_695564.description: A British mother says counterterrorism officers questioned her about her support for Israel and a trip to the country after an anonymous extremism referral.

flash_695562.description: Two young men were arrested on suspicion of calling airports in Spain, warning of explosive devices, and attempting to extort money.

flash_695560.description: The weather today (Sunday) will be partly cloudy to cloudy, with light local rain in the north of the country and along the coastal plain. Temperatures will continue to be lower than normal for the season, especially in the mountains and inland. The night will be partly cloudy to cloudy, and in the morning there may be drizzle along the coast.

flash_695558.description:
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has informed US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that his country is ready to participate in a military meeting with Israel, a source familiar with the details told the Asharq Al-Awsat newspaper.

According to the report, Beirut hopes that the meeting will lead to a commitment from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to a ceasefire, and to expanding the activity of the "verification mechanism" for the purpose of deploying the Lebanese army in the "pilot area." Aoun announced yesterday that the next round of talks between Israel and Lebanon will take place on October 20 in Tampa, Florida. According to him, Lebanon will send a military delegation to the meeting to present its demand that Israel stop the escalation in Lebanese territory.

flash_695557.description:
About two and a half weeks before the midterm elections in the United States, Senator Darlene Graham Nordon, sister of the late Senator Lindsey Graham, criticized President Donald Trump's decision to exempt Russia from the new sanctions imposed by the law bearing her brother's name.

"Personally, I would choose to put pressure on Russia to end the war and lower gas prices. I don't trust Putin, and I don't trust Russia," she said.

flash_695555.description:
US Vice President J.D. Vance, in an interview with CBS, addressed the war against Iran and claimed that the United States has already achieved decisive achievements in the campaign, even though the Iranians continue to respond to actions against them.

"I would say that in some ways we have already achieved a decisive victory, but the Iranians, the enemy also have an influence on what is happening here and they have responded in certain ways," Vance said. Referring to Tehran's nuclear program, he added: "Iran cannot have nuclear weapons. Have we destroyed the Iranian nuclear program? The answer is yes."

flash_695553.description: Amcha Yisrael candidate Yoseph Haddad claims Likud tried to recruit him until the last minute.

flash_695549.description: In interview with Mark Levin, Netanyahu discusses Trump's approach to Iran, warns of Tehran's nuclear ambitions, defends Israel's actions in Gaza and looks ahead to Israel's election.

flash_695547.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio calls on Israel to curb violence in Judea and Samaria after Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine was injured.

flash_695585.description:
Iran’s new Defense Minister, Mehrdad Ahlaghki Ketabchi, announced that Iran is making progress in developing an indigenously produced heavy fighter jet, expressing hope that the aircraft will make its maiden flight in 2027.

According to the minister, the aircraft’s initial testing phases are scheduled to take place later this year. The announcement comes as Iran pursues plans to develop independent capabilities to manufacture heavy, multirole fighter jets.

flash_695584.description:
A police chase involving a vehicle stolen from Jerusalem ended with the arrest of a suspect near Tekoa after he reportedly endangered officers and attempted to ram a police vehicle. During the pursuit, officers fired at the vehicle’s tires in an attempt to stop it.

After the vehicle came to a halt, the suspect attempted to flee on foot toward nearby orchards. Officers continued pursuing him and managed to apprehend him.

flash_695582.description: Amid concerns over haredi voter apathy ahead of the elections, leading Torah sages convened in Bnei Brak, urging voter turnout, political unity, and opposition to yeshiva students’ conscription.

flash_695580.description: Meir Bertler of Shomer Yosh calls poisoning incidents in Judea and Samaria 'a new form of terrorism,' saying poison is being spread in grazing areas and water sources.

flash_695578.description: Kaplan Medical Center's cardiology chief faces allegations of collecting blood samples without patient consent, weeks after a residency training scandal emerged.

flash_695576.description: Director General of the Ministry of Religious Services demands an investigation into Haaretz journalist Yael Friedson on suspicion of incitement to violence.

flash_695573.description:
On October 20, President Isaac Herzog will depart for a 12-hour visit to Budapest, Hungary. During the visit, President Herzog will be received at the Sándor Palace by President András Baka of Hungary. The two presidents will hold a diplomatic meeting to discuss deepening cooperation and strengthening relations between the two countries. President Herzog will then meet with the Prime Minister of Hungary, Péter Magyar, for a diplomatic meeting on advancing bilateral cooperation between the two countries.

At the center of the visit will be President Herzog’s address to the international Voice of the People conference. The conference is part of a global initiative established by President Herzog that brings together Jewish leaders and young people from the Diaspora and from Israel, with the aim of strengthening ties and advancing a shared dialogue on the challenges facing the Jewish people. President Herzog will conclude the visit with a meeting with the leaders of Hungary’s Jewish community.

flash_695572.description: A mathematics teacher at a public school in Brooklyn, New York, posted a caricature of the Argentine soccer star resembling Nazi propaganda.

flash_695570.description: Arutz Sheva's Election Barometer finds 65% of coalition voters expect Netanyahu to remain PM, while 48% of opposition voters predict a change.

flash_695568.description: New JPPI survey finds the political right dominating Jewish Israelis' self-identification, while security tops voter priorities and 79% view elections as critical.

flash_695565.description: MK Yitzhak Kroizer will appear for questioning following a confrontation with police in Mitzpe Yericho.

flash_695563.description: The IDF is allowing Lebanese and Syrian workers to enter agricultural areas within the security zone in southern Lebanon to harvest olives, in coordination with and under the supervision of Israeli troops.

flash_695559.description: Almost no one foresaw that hatred of the Jew as a person would be transferred, as condemnation, to the Jewish State. Opinion.

flash_695556.description: Violent riots sweep across France as historic buildings burn, businesses are looted, 150 police officers are injured, and 1,200 people are arrested.

flash_695597.description: In Belfast, Obama repeated a dishonest, mendacious, and vile charge while concealing the evidence needed to judge it - because that evidence would refute it. Opinion.

flash_695596.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir orders troops to remain on duty during Israel's October 27 elections amid fears of a regional escalation involving Iran or its proxies.

flash_695594.description: Netanyahu rejects claims he was part of the pre-October 7th 'conception,' defends his 'total victory' pledge, and vows to establish a balanced commission of inquiry if reelected.

flash_695592.description: Rabbi Chaim Yerucham Smotrich explains why he wears a suit when going to vote and warns that a minority government would undermine the Jewish majority.

flash_695590.description: Iran’s new defense minister claims he has been on a hit list for 35 years. After his predecessor was killed, he threatened Israel and the US and revealed how Iran fortifies its military facilities.

flash_695588.description: Eyal Berkovic recalls tensions with Muslim teammates at Manchester City: '12 Muslims against Eyal,' also describing his suspicions about the team’s chef, 'I was scared they would poison me.'

flash_695586.description: An Israeli was killed in a motorcycle accident in Thailand’s Krabi province. His family has been notified, and the Foreign Ministry is arranging the return of his body to Israel. The accident is under investigation.

flash_695583.description:
President Donald Trump commented on the riots that took place in France yesterday.

Trump wrote on Truth Social: “France is burning! The immigration of people from a completely different world, people whose hearts are filled with hatred, has destroyed what was once a great and glorious country. Close your borders and take control, before it’s too late!"

flash_695581.description: What Yemen should teach the West about Israel’s enemies. Opinion.

flash_695577.description: Today, there are wise and discerning haredim are willing to say out loud: "We want to join our brothers and sisters in defending and contributing to our state! Give us ways to do so that respect our principles, and we will be there, with you and for you." Opinion.

flash_695575.description: After days of speculation, the Gerrer Rebbe has instructed his followers to vote for United Torah Judaism. However, the limited wording of his directive and the absence of instructions to campaign have sparked controversy in the political arena.

flash_695574.description: Security coordinators protested outside IDF headquarters in Tel Aviv, demanding intervention over the alleged harsh detention of a colleague from Samaria.

flash_695571.description: Rioters wreak havoc in 19th Arrondissement synagogue, throwing holy books and religious items on the floor, as violent riots rock the country.

flash_695569.description: The Prime Minister presented a plan Sunday morning to enlist 23,000 haredi men over three and a half years and issued a stern warning to those who categorically oppose military service.

flash_695603.description: Austrian Airlines flight from Ben Gurion Airport to Vienna declares an in-flight emergency following a reported bomb threat. No explosive device has been confirmed.

flash_695602.description: Prestigious award presented on Yom Ha'aliyah recognizes English-speaking immigrants whose contributions have made a lasting impact on the State of Israel

flash_695601.description: Nine days before Israel’s elections, Trump gives Netanyahu his “Complete and Total Endorsement" in an unprecedented intervention, Axios’ Barak Ravid reports.

flash_695600.description: Negev and Galilee Minister Yitzhak Waserlauf is verbally harassed by left-wing activist while visiting Tel Aviv clinic with newborn son.

flash_695599.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef rules that supporting Otzma Yehudit is prohibited under Jewish law because of Itamar Ben Gvir's visits to the Temple Mount and his encouragement of others to ascend the site.

flash_695595.description: Former minister Michael Malkieli warns haredi voters who stay home or support parties unlikely to enter Knesset could help bring left to power, threaten Israel's Jewish identity.

flash_695593.description: US President Donald Trump announces support for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, calling him a 'great warrior' and 'even greater partner for peace.'

flash_695591.description: Saudi Arabia: Sirens sound in southern city of Najran

flash_695587.description: Aliyah is a tikun for The Sin of the Spies.

flash_695579.description: An inspection of a suspicious vehicle in Dura uncovered a Hamas flag and stolen Israeli license plates, leading to a search of a nearby garage where handguns and an improvised firearm were discovered.

flash_695611.description: Nine days before elections, Moti Leitner rejects calls to withdraw his HaTzibbur HaCharedi party, insisting it will cross.

flash_695610.description:
Violent riots erupted in Milan for the second consecutive day amid protests over the rising cost of living. The demonstrations escalated into widespread looting in the city center.

According to media reports, more than 200 people have been arrested, over 80% of them minors. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced that she will convene an emergency meeting tomorrow in response to the unrest.

flash_695609.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warns Trump after his endorsement of Netanyahu in Israel's election, accusing the Prime Minister of seeking another war.

flash_695608.description: Nine days before Israel's elections, three polls show differing results: Eisenkot leads in Kan 11's survey, while Likud tops the i24NEWS and Channel 14 polls.

flash_695607.description: Lufthansa Group confirmed Sunday evening that a bomb threat had been received concerning an Austrian Airlines aircraft traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna, Austria. Following the threat, the flight was diverted for an emergency landing in Sofia, Bulgaria's capital.

flash_695606.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu outlines ten principles for Israel's security, emphasizing preemptive strikes, military independence, defeating enemies, and strengthening the nation's Jewish identity.

flash_695605.description: Macron vows to prosecute rioters as more than 2,000 are arrested and over 600 security personnel injured in unrest across France.

flash_695604.description: Likud activist Shlomi Vaknin holds up pacifier during live interview, mocking Yashar! leader Gadi Eisenkot's reaction to being called a 'monkey' by media personality Yinon Magal.

flash_695598.description: Each of us must find our own “Noah’s ark" that will provide us with stability and protection in a turbulent world:

flash_695589.description:
Aliyah and Integration Minister Ofir Sofer condemned the vandalism of a synagogue in Paris and ordered steps to accelerate the immigration to Israel of French Jews who have already opened aliyah files.

As part of the initiative, the ministry will proactively contact prospective immigrants to help remove obstacles and encourage them to make aliyah immediately.

Sofer criticized French President Emmanuel Macron and called on his government to combat antisemitism and ensure the safety of the Jewish community.
